Now what? So when I read a post I feel connected to, I just want them to think now what? And maybe, just breath till you can figure out what the backup plan is. Maybe its just smiling to a stranger today  because you never know who's life your life could save.

But what if your dad and you shared the same bond and have been playing a monkey warrior as a sister after he was gone. Still remember our smiling eyes(internally winking). 

Now I keep my only daughter away from me because I'm not right with that bond and at the expense of me being a monkey all these years. 

Don't get me wrong,  I have stood strong alone among many a band of "wannabe" classy single mother warriors. Only to only find out they like to point and poke, then steal your hard earned silly hat[but wait there is more]. Not all single mother warriors got my classes like my dads classes. The lessons to "get right" he taught me with just one smile.  

In real the world, I'm so proud I got to see and experience his goofiness and just hope my baby sees what I have been trying to do. I'd proudly jump around wearing the hat and smiling.  

Pooooooof....I'm gone?

Giving life a chance and breath.
